# Smart Pharma System

> Smart Pharma System is a comprehensive inventory, task, and production management dashboard designed for pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprises.

## Main Pages

- [Login](/login): Secure authentication gateway for all users.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Aggregates system metrics, production indicators, and quick links.
- [Tasks](/tasks): Creation, assignment, and status updates for foil and cylinder engraving tasks.
- [Inventory](/stock): Role-gated management of foil and cylinder stocks, barcode scans, and activity logs.
- [Attendance](/attendance): Tracking check-in/out schedules and working hours.
- [Leave Management](/leave): Form submission and management of staff leave requests.
- [Reports](/reports): Automated and downloadable reports for audit and operations.
- [Chat](/chat): Secure real-time peer communication channel.
- [Settings](/settings): Application customizations and configuration options.
- [User Management](/user-management): Administrator control panel for managing system users.
- [Salary Management](/salary): Employee salary details and payout structures.
